publish.description: Installs Junk Store Pro, the original game mode launcher. The non-Steam game library launcher for Steam Deck: access your Epic, GOG, Amazon and itch libraries, plus emulators and ROMs, from Game Mode. This is a paid product with a 7 day free trial, $39.99 and 12 months of updates. If you don't want updates beyond that, cancel any time and the software keeps working; updates require payment. Version 3 does not break with steam updates and does not require decky loader: https://www.junkstore.xyz/status/
